title: Couchbase Server image release lines 7.2 and older are end-of-life
summary: These Couchbase Server release lines are past their end-of-life date in the vendor's lifecycle schedule (7.2 reached end of life in July 2026; 7.6 is supported until March 2027).
replacement: A couchbase image on a supported release line

constraints: Keep the base image, Compose image, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use couchbase on one supported Couchbase Server release line.
Confirm the application and its data or configuration work on the target Couchbase Server release; read the vendor's upgrade notes before moving across several release lines.

steps.title: Update the base image
steps.instructions: Change the reported FROM line or Compose image to a tag on a supported release line, and pin it to a digest if your policy requires.

steps.title: Align other image references
steps.instructions: Update other Dockerfiles, Compose files, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use the same image so they agree.

verification.purpose: Build the image on the new base.
Confirm the container starts on the new base.
